Do I still trade on Hyperliquid?+

Yes. Orders execute on Hyperliquid through a fresh trading account.

Is ShieldTX the same speed as Hyperliquid?+

Shielding adds a few seconds before order submission.

What exactly is shielded?+

The public association between your main wallet and trading data.

Can someone still see activity on-chain?+

Yes. Deposits, temporary accounts, solver activity and withdrawals remain visible.

Is this like Tornado Cash?+

No. ShieldTX isolates perpetual-trade execution data.

What markets are supported?+

Every Hyperliquid perpetual market.

Does shielding affect my fills?+

Orders use Hyperliquid liquidity. Shielding adds no spread.

What does it cost?+

Private-beta pricing applies. See current pricing ↗

Who controls my funds?+

You authorize movements from the onchain vault. Read the full trust model ↗
